onset.Description: Measured onset of the event, from the first scanner trigger

duration.Description: phase1/phase2: planned display time; phase3: response time (full window if no response); response: 0

Levels.phase1_employer: Employer photos and family background of both offers
Levels.phase2_offer: Full offers: background, salary, off days, workload
Levels.phase3_decision: Decision screen with the four answer options

trial_id.Description: Row of stimuli_data/design/njm_fmri_trials.csv (the same pair of offers for every participant)

Levels.tradeoff: Offers differ in job terms; neither is better on everything
Levels.identical_terms: Same job terms, different employer origin
Levels.catch: Same employer origin, one offer better on salary, off days and workload

dominant_side.Description: Catch trials: side of the better offer (A = left, B = right)

swapped.Description: 1 = the two offers of this trial_id are shown in swapped left/right position for this participant

A_origin.Description: Employer origin of Offer A (left); B_origin for Offer B (right)

A_face.Description: Photo file shown for the employer (stimuli_data/faces)

A_rest_days.Description: Rest days per week (0, 0.5 = one day every two weeks, 1)

response_button.Description: Button pressed: 1 index, 2 middle, 3 ring, 4 little finger of the right hand

response_time.Description: Time from the onset of the decision screen to the button press

timeout.Description: 1 = no response within the decision window

catch_pass.Description: Catch trials: 1 = chose the better offer, 0 = did not (or no response)

chosen_origin.Description: Attributes of the chosen offer (chosen_origin, chosen_salary_aed, chosen_rest_days, chosen_workload)

TestRun.Description: NOT REAL DATA: produced by the task in test mode
